sourceNote: Catalog entries were derived from the BlazerGames repository's index.html links and on-disk game directories. Only files present in that repository are listed. The original 'minecraft' card in the source site linked to the games directory itself (broken link) and is therefore excluded. Additional entries from github.com/BlueDonuts/unblocked-games (NettleWeb): 82 self-hosted HTML5 games (folders prefixed nw-) and 1,113 external-catalog HTML5 games (ids prefixed nwx-, loaded from third-party CDNs) — these are included in the catalog as external entries; their thumbnails come from the htmlgames.com CDN, the NettleWeb image library, or generated letter tiles. The external entries from the Interstellar catalog (135, ids prefixed intx-) and the GameMonetize publisher feed (9,949, ids prefixed gmx-) were restored from this repository history. Flash and DOS entries from that repository were not included: they live inside a 4.4 GB chunk archive that is not practical to self-host. Entries duplicating existing titles (Vex 3-7, 2048, Slope) and one unindexed folder (m890avdt) were skipped. Additional external entries from the Interstellar project (github.com/UseInterstellar/Interstellar): 153 links verified to load and allow embedding at integration time; thumbnails copied from that repository. Additional external entries from the GameMonetize publisher feed (rss.gamemonetize.com): 9949 games whose URLs were each verified to load and allow iframe embedding at integration time; thumbnails are referenced directly from img.gamemonetize.com.

verification.entryPoint: All local entry points verified on disk by scripts/verify-catalog.js. External (nwx-) entries point at third-party servers and are validated as URL format only.
verification.manual: Not every game has been manually played end-to-end. Playability beyond page load is not guaranteed; see README.
verification.thumbnails: Thumbnail files were copied verbatim from the source repository images directory and matched to games by filename. The 82 NettleWeb folders, 1v1.LOL and 2048 use images sourced from the NettleWeb repository (github.com/BlueDonuts/unblocked-games) d/ image library, matched by title via scripts/fetch-thumbnails.mjs. Tuff Client uses a generated SVG card.
